method: Target ROI crop edit from exact source-pixel hand frame, enlarged 8x nearest-neighbor for model input

source_reference.method: Exact crop of body_full.png; 8x nearest-neighbor only, no image content added.

review: Rejected: the model redrew/enlarged the cuff and arm, produced an oversized hand with heavier/smoother contours than the Chibi source, and returned an opaque RGB checkerboard. Multiple digits show, but registration, target scale, style, and alpha gates fail.

post_rubric_review.criterion: at least three clearly separated rounded fingertip lobes; fourth may naturally overlap
post_rubric_review.result: digit-count roughly passes as a concept, but overall candidate rejected for scale, cuff redraw, style, and opaque background
